name: Ferrafor, Young Yew
oracle_text:
When Ferrafor enters, create a number of 1/1 green Saproling creature tokens equal to the number of counters among creatures target player controls.
{T}: Double the number of each kind of counter on target creature.
blocked_sentences: When Ferrafor enters, create a number of 1/1 green Saproling creature tokens equal to the number of counters among creatures target player controls.

needs.what: a value that sums counters of every kind on the objects a selector matches, e.g. {"counters_on": {"counter": "any", "objects": {"types": ["Creature"], "controller": {"target": "t1"}}}} -- "the number of counters among creatures target player controls", read live at resolution
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `counters_on` requires one named counter kind (validate_counters_on refuses a missing kind and the evaluator reads obj.counter(kind)), and counter kinds are open-ended, so summing a fixed list of kinds would not be the printed card. `counters_had` does accept "any" but only reads the had_counters snapshot bound by a leaves-the-battlefield event, not live permanents. The token (saproling_1_1_g), the target player, and the {T} line (double_counters) are all expressible.
